_readme: Add a company by appending an object to `companies`. `cebeTicker` = ticker used by https://cebetracker.io/api/v1/companies.json (balance-sheet source). `quote` = Yahoo Finance symbol for the live stock price (e.g. MSTR, ASST, 3350.T). `currency` = currency of that quote; non-USD quotes are converted with Yahoo FX (e.g. JPY=X). `manual` = optional overrides used when the CEBE feed lacks a company or you want to pin a value from a filing (btc_holdings, debt_usd, preferred_usd, cash_usd, strc_holdings_usd, basic_shares, diluted_shares, source, as_of). Manual values WIN over the feed, so remove them once stale. `sec_cik` = optional 10-digit SEC CIK. When set, the update script records the latest 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-Q/A, 10-K, or 10-K/A from EDGAR and the page links to it. Figures stay on the CEBE/manual values. Leave `sec_cik` unset for companies that do not file with the SEC. Optional `sec_ticker` overrides `ticker` when the EDGAR symbol differs from the display ticker.

manual.diluted_shares_source: Strive 8-K filed 2026-10-19 (as of 2026-10-16), Assumed Fully Diluted Shares: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1920406/000162828026066222/asst-20261019.htm
